claims.text: On LT4 w sus or confirmed preg (ex, + home test): pt ↑own LT4 dose by ~20%–30% and urgently notifies clinician.
claims.quote: Hypothyroid patients receiving LT4 treatment with a suspected or confirmed pregnancy (e.g., positive home pregnancy test) should independently increase their dose of LT4 by ∼20%–30% and urgently notify their caregiver for prompt testing and further evaluation.
claims.locator: Alexander EK, et al. 2017 Guidelines of the American Thyroid Association for the Diagnosis and Management of Thyroid Disease During Pregnancy and the Postpartum. Thyroid 2017;27(3):315-389

claims.text: One way: two additional tablets weekly of the current daily dose.
claims.quote: One means of accomplishing this is to administer two additional tablets weekly of the patient's current daily LT4 dosage.
claims.locator: Alexander EK, et al. 2017 Guidelines of the American Thyroid Association for the Diagnosis and Management of Thyroid Disease During Pregnancy and the Postpartum. Thyroid 2017;27(3):315-389
